items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams is week-to-week with hamstring injury suffered Sunday, underwent MRI, and will likely miss some time. Same left hamstring he injured in college; Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: HC Ben Johnson on ESPN1000 after MRI; non-contact scramble injury
items.implication: Miss at least Week 3 likely; monitor for MNF vs PHI
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume/targets for CHI WRs/TE/RB if Bagent starts

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered dislocated left elbow (same as last year), X-rays negative, ruled out Sunday, expected to miss time (~month previously). Imaging Monday and consulting experts; Marcus Mariota expected to start vs SEA.
items.why: Dislocated non-throwing elbow bracing fall; HC Quinn confirmed; prior history
items.implication: Mariota starts Week 3; Daniels multi-week absence likely
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for WAS pass-catchers with backup QB

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible). RJ Harvey inactive.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Harvey out opens RB work
items.opportunity: Harvey absence elevates other DEN RBs

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through two weeks opportunities Bucky 36 vs Gainwell 12. Sean Tucker active but zero offensive snaps.
items.implication: Clear lead back; start with confidence; Gainwell limited
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/route share as primary RB

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson’s explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out, even without fumbles.
items.why: Fumble punishment + scheme need for explosiveness + Brown absence
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson docked on trust
items.opportunity: Increased carries/routes for Henderson in weapon-thin offense

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per model.
items.why: High target share + expected points leadership
items.opportunity: Sustained high target share/routes in PHI offense

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI today after stinger; hope it is minor. He played through it after leaving early, limited second-half work.
items.why: Stinger left arm/shoulder; returned with neck roll; cautious MRI
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 if minor; monitor results
items.opportunity: If out, handcuff/backup RB work expands

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans’ hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in fourth quarter if needed. Demarcus Robinson high-ankle sprain separate issue.
Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on Brock Bowers: “Close, very close. He looks great.” Trending toward Week 3 debut after knee procedure.
items.why: HC comments; limited practice progress after meniscus trim
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active Week 3 vs NO; stash priority
items.opportunity: Full TE role/snaps/routes upon return; Mayer temporary

items.text: Sunday fantasy injuries watching: Caleb Williams hamstring, Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow, Saquon Barkley stinger, Jadarian Price chest, Jayden Reed head, Jonathon Brooks groin, Rico Dowdle toe, Aaron Jones knee, JK Dobbins hamstring, Dallas Goedert knee, Mike Evans hip (not serious), plus Njoku/Kolar etc.
items.implication: Multiple high-value players for Week 3 status checks
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and depth chart risers if absences confirmed

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Ladd McConkey GTD optimism (flak jacket); Puka Nacua GTD hip; RJ Harvey not expected (hamstring); Chris Olave/Joe Burrow expected; Zay Flowers OUT hamstring; Michael Pittman OUT foot.
items.implication: Flowers/Pittman clear outs; McConkey/Nacua monitor; Olave/Burrow startable
items.opportunity: Pittman out opens IND WR targets; Harvey out DEN RB shares

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT; Michael Pittman (foot) OUT per weekend reports.
items.opportunity: BAL WR targets to others; IND WR2/3 upside (Pierce/Downs)

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps; David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Gadsden 29-of-67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.implication: If Njoku/Kolar limited, Gadsden TE streaming/upside

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a handful of WRs worse (incl. Quentin Johnston, Jordan Addison).
items.why: YPRR efficiency data through two weeks
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite targets; monitor role/QB play
